transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering. We've got the festival trailer picture-locked at 60 seconds and it's going up this week, so we need to settle the music clearance today. Our shortlist is down to "Static Bloom" and "Neon Weather," and this trailer will be running both online and in cinema pre-roll. Before I make the final call and record the approved delivery package, I want to hear from each of you — rights, label, editorial, and festival-submissions leads. Let's go through the standard clearance huddle. Who wants to start?

transcript.text: I'll start. I reviewed the executed publishing license for "Static Bloom" yesterday. The composition may be used in the official trailer only for a cue of no more than 42 seconds, with the exact credit "Written by Celia Voss." I have not yet entered these terms in the clearance tracker, but the review is complete and the license is signed.
